subject: What a lovely tracking update
body: Fantastic, the tracking for order #6939 hasn’t changed in two days, even though the delivery estimate is still a week away. Could someone check whether it’s moving?
summary: The customer’s tracking has not updated in two days and asks whether the shipment is moving.

subject: A truly memorable refund experience
body: Wonderful news: the refund for order #5024 finally arrived, just one day later than promised and after only two emails from me. Glad that’s over.
summary: The customer received a delayed refund after following up twice and is unhappy with the experience.

subject: An exciting new smoke feature
body: Love the surprise feature on the kettle from order #22673: it started smoking at the base during its first use. I unplugged it immediately, but this is clearly unsafe. Please tell me how to handle it.
summary: The customer’s kettle smoked during first use, creating a safety hazard.

subject: Enjoying my new account lockout
body: Fantastic, I’m locked out of my ShopFlow account and can’t sign in at all. The password reset link just sends me back to the login page, so I’m completely stuck. Please help me get access.
summary: The customer is unable to access their account because the password reset link does not work.

subject: A receipt with bonus tax
body: I love a receipt that lists sales tax twice. The card charge is correct, thankfully, but the receipt for order #15707 is wrong. Could you send me a corrected one?
summary: The customer’s receipt lists sales tax twice and asks for a corrected copy.

subject: What a helpful comparison list
body: Brilliant feature: your product comparison list disappears every time I add a second item. Could someone fix it? Comparing products one at a time is a real treat.
summary: The customer’s product comparison list clears when they add a second item.

subject: A delivery with a thrilling mystery
body: Wonderful, the package for order #11962 has been stuck at the same depot for ten days with no explanation. If it isn’t located by tomorrow, I’ll have to dispute the charge. Please sort this out.
summary: The customer’s package has been stalled for ten days and they threaten a charge dispute if it is not located.

subject: A refund arriving right on time
body: Just wonderful: I returned the blender from order #8847 weeks ago, and the promised refund still hasn’t arrived. I need that money for rent due tomorrow, so please get it back to me urgently.
summary: The customer’s overdue refund is needed for rent due tomorrow.

subject: An impressive new grinding sound
body: The coffee grinder from order #7486 has developed a loud grinding rattle after a week of normal use. Love the extra noise, but it doesn’t seem right. Can you advise on a repair or replacement?
summary: The customer’s coffee grinder developed a loud rattle after a week of normal use.

subject: A charming surprise in my account
body: Great, I received a password-reset email I didn’t request, and now I can’t get into my account. Please secure it immediately—I’m worried someone else has access.
summary: The customer suspects someone else accessed their account after an unexpected password-reset email and is now locked out.

subject: Duplicate charge on my headphones
body: My card was charged twice for order #17040, and I can see both charges posted. The receipt also has my old billing address. The duplicate charge is what I need fixed first—please reverse one of the charges.
summary: The customer was charged twice for headphones and wants one charge reversed; the receipt also shows an old billing address.

subject: My package still hasn't arrived
body: Order #21584 was due three weeks ago and tracking hasn't updated since it left the warehouse. The missing delivery matters most; I need to know where the package is or have it replaced. Also, the shipping confirmation has the wrong color listed.
summary: The customer's package is three weeks overdue with no tracking updates, and the shipping confirmation lists the wrong color.

subject: Returning a jacket for a refund
body: I sent the jacket back last week because the sleeves are too short, and I'd like the refund when the return is processed. That refund is the main thing I'm checking on. The size chart was also confusing, so I may need help choosing a size if I reorder.
summary: The customer wants a refund for a returned jacket and also found the size chart confusing.

subject: Coffee grinder arrived completely dead
body: The grinder in order #17188 won't turn on at all, even after trying another outlet. Getting a working grinder is my main concern because I can't use it. The hopper is also a different color from the one shown online.
summary: The customer's grinder will not turn on, preventing use, and its hopper color differs from the online listing.

subject: Small profile name correction
body: I got locked out yesterday but the password reset fixed that, so that's no longer a problem. What matters now is changing the display name on my profile from “Michele” to “Michelle.” I also can't find where to update my newsletter preferences.
summary: The customer wants a minor profile-name correction and help finding newsletter preferences; a prior login issue is already resolved.

subject: Second charge for my coffee order
body: I was charged twice for order #6995, and both transactions have posted to my card. Please reverse the extra charge first—that's the issue that matters most. The invoice also doesn't show the discount code I used.
summary: The customer has two posted charges for one coffee order and wants the duplicate reversed; the invoice also omits a discount.

subject: Gift message missing from checkout
body: I added a gift message for the recipient, but it didn't appear on the preview or confirmation. Getting that message included is the main thing I need help with. I also couldn't find the gift receipt option, and the wrapping paper choices were hard to distinguish.
summary: The customer's gift message was omitted, and they also couldn't find a gift receipt option or distinguish wrapping choices.

subject: Tracking hasn't moved since yesterday
body: Tracking for order #16721 has shown “label created” since yesterday, and I can't tell whether the parcel has actually been picked up. A realistic delivery estimate is what I need most. Also, can you tell the carrier to leave it at the side door?
summary: The customer's tracking has not progressed beyond label creation since yesterday, and they want an estimate and side-door delivery.

subject: Refund for the returned kettle
body: I returned the kettle because it was too large for my counter, and I'd like the purchase refunded once the return is checked in. The refund is my main question. I also noticed the product page doesn't say whether the handle is removable, which would have helped me decide.
summary: The customer wants a refund for a returned kettle and says the product page lacked information about its handle.

subject: La lámpara parpadea desde que la saqué de la caja
body: Compré una lámpara de mesa y la luz parpadea continuamente, incluso después de probarla en otros enchufes. ¿Me indican cómo gestionar una reparación o cambio?
summary: La lámpara parpadea incluso al conectarla en distintos enchufes y el cliente pregunta cómo repararla o cambiarla.

subject: Quiero corregir el nombre de mi perfil
body: Hola, en mi perfil aparece mal escrito mi apellido. Puedo entrar sin problema, pero no encuentro dónde editarlo. ¿Me orientan?
summary: El cliente puede acceder a su cuenta, pero necesita ayuda para corregir su apellido en el perfil.

subject: Me cobraron dos veces el mismo pedido
body: Veo dos cargos idénticos de ShopFlow en mi tarjeta por una sola compra. Necesito que revisen el cobro duplicado y me devuelvan el importe cuanto antes.
summary: El cliente detecta dos cargos por una compra y solicita la devolución del cargo duplicado.

subject: ¿Tienen tiendas donde pueda ver los productos?
body: Estoy pensando en comprar una cafetera y quería saber si ShopFlow tiene algún local o sala de exposición para ver los modelos en persona.
summary: El cliente pregunta si ShopFlow tiene locales o salas de exposición para ver productos.

subject: El paquete bloquea la escalera de emergencia
body: El repartidor dejó un paquete grande atravesado en la escalera de emergencia del edificio. Los vecinos no pueden pasar por esa salida; por favor, hagan que lo retiren de inmediato.
summary: Un paquete entregado quedó bloqueando la escalera de emergencia y representa un peligro para los vecinos.

subject: Necesito devolver unas cortinas
body: Las cortinas no combinan con la habitación y están sin usar, con el embalaje intacto. ¿Podrían indicarme los pasos y el plazo para devolverlas?
summary: El cliente quiere devolver unas cortinas sin usar y pregunta por el proceso y el plazo.

subject: El cargador del portátil dejó de funcionar
body: El cargador que compré dejó de cargar de repente y ya probé con otro enchufe. Trabajo desde casa y ahora mismo no puedo usar el portátil; necesito una solución lo antes posible.
summary: El cargador dejó de funcionar y el cliente no puede usar su portátil para trabajar desde casa.

subject: No puedo entrar a mi cuenta
body: Desde esta mañana la página rechaza mi contraseña aunque la restablecí dos veces. Estoy bloqueada fuera de mi cuenta y necesito acceder a mis datos hoy.
summary: El cliente sigue sin poder iniciar sesión tras restablecer la contraseña y necesita acceder a su cuenta.

subject: Consulta sobre una factura
body: ¿Puedo descargar una factura con el desglose de impuestos de una compra anterior? No la encuentro en el correo de confirmación. Gracias.
summary: El cliente pregunta si puede descargar una factura con el desglose de impuestos.

subject: La herramienta de comparación no carga
body: Estoy intentando comparar dos monitores y la herramienta se queda cargando sin mostrar nada. Necesito elegir uno para reemplazar el que uso para trabajar hoy, pero ahora mismo no puedo avanzar con la compra. ¿Pueden ayudarme?
summary: La herramienta de comparación no carga y el cliente no puede elegir un monitor para comprar hoy.

subject: Colis introuvable — contestation bancaire imminente
body: Le suivi indique « livré », mais je n’ai rien reçu et mes voisins non plus. Si vous ne localisez pas le colis aujourd’hui, je contesterai le paiement auprès de ma banque. Merci de régler ça sans délai.
summary: The customer has not received a package marked delivered and threatens to dispute the charge with their bank.

subject: Retour d’un pull trop grand
body: Bonjour, le pull est joli, mais il est beaucoup trop grand. Pourriez-vous m’indiquer la marche à suivre pour le retourner et obtenir un remboursement ?
summary: The customer wants instructions for returning an oversized sweater and receiving a refund.

subject: Multiprise qui a commencé à fumer
body: La multiprise achetée chez vous a fait des étincelles puis s’est mise à fumer dès que je l’ai branchée. Je l’ai déconnectée et je ne la réutiliserai pas. J’ai besoin d’aide tout de suite pour éviter tout risque.
summary: The customer reports a smoking, sparking power strip and needs urgent help due to a safety hazard.

subject: Impossible de me connecter à mon compte
body: Depuis ce matin, mon mot de passe est refusé et la réinitialisation ne fonctionne pas : je suis complètement bloquée hors de mon compte. Pouvez-vous m’aider à y accéder rapidement ?
summary: The customer is locked out of their account and password recovery is not working.

subject: Paiement débité deux fois
body: J’ai passé une seule fois ma commande, mais deux débits identiques apparaissent sur ma carte. Merci de vérifier et de me rembourser le doublon rapidement.
summary: The customer was charged twice for a single purchase and requests a prompt refund of the duplicate charge.

subject: Le site bloque à chaque tentative de commande
body: J’essaie d’acheter une lampe depuis ce matin, mais le site affiche une erreur avant même de me proposer le paiement. J’ai essayé sur deux navigateurs : impossible d’aller au bout de l’achat. Pouvez-vous corriger le problème ?
summary: A website error blocks the customer from completing a purchase before reaching payment.

subject: Colis toujours absent après trois semaines
body: Mon colis n’est toujours pas arrivé après trois semaines et le suivi n’a pas bougé depuis son départ de l’entrepôt. Pouvez-vous retrouver l’envoi ou me dire quand il sera livré ?
summary: The customer has been waiting three weeks for a package, with no recent tracking updates.

subject: Question sur le délai de remboursement
body: Bonjour, j’ai déposé mon retour au point relais hier. Savez-vous combien de temps il faut généralement pour que le remboursement apparaisse sur ma carte ?
summary: The customer asks how long a refund usually takes to appear after dropping off a return.

subject: Ordinateur portable inutilisable avant le travail
body: Mon ordinateur portable s’éteint quelques secondes après le démarrage et ne tient plus la charge. J’en ai besoin pour travailler et je suis bloqué pour mes tâches aujourd’hui. Quelle solution pouvez-vous proposer ?
summary: The customer's laptop shuts down shortly after startup, leaving them unable to work.

subject: Activité inconnue sur mon compte
body: Je viens de recevoir une alerte de connexion depuis une ville où je ne suis jamais allé, et mon adresse e-mail de compte a été modifiée sans mon accord. Je crains que quelqu’un ait pris le contrôle de mon compte. Bloquez-le et aidez-moi à le récupérer immédiatement.
summary: The customer reports an unauthorized login and email change, indicating possible account takeover.

subject: Firmenname auf der Rechnung ändern
body: Guten Tag, bei meiner Bestellung wurde die Rechnung auf meinen privaten Namen ausgestellt. Könnten Sie sie bitte auf „Meyer Design GmbH“ umschreiben? Vielen Dank.
summary: The customer requests a corrected invoice with their company name.

subject: Bitte stellt meinen gelöschten Beitrag wieder her
body: Ihr habt meinen sachlichen Beitrag im öffentlichen ShopFlow-Forum ohne Erklärung entfernt und mir geschrieben, ich solle mich nicht mehr dazu äußern. Wenn ihr ihn nicht bis morgen wiederherstellt, lasse ich das anwaltlich prüfen.
summary: The customer threatens legal action unless a removed forum post is restored.

subject: Sendungsverfolgung aktualisiert sich nicht
body: Hallo, bei meiner Bestellung #10682 steht seit gestern nur „Daten elektronisch angekündigt“. Könnt ihr nachsehen, ob das Paket schon an den Versanddienst übergeben wurde?
summary: The customer asks for an update because tracking has not changed since yesterday.

subject: Rücksendung einer ungeöffneten Kaffeemaschine
body: Guten Tag, ich möchte die ungeöffnete Kaffeemaschine aus meiner Bestellung zurückgeben. Bitte schicken Sie mir die Anleitung und ein Rücksendeetikett.
summary: The customer wants to return an unopened coffee machine and requests a return label.

subject: Wasserkocher schaltet nicht mehr ab
body: Der Wasserkocher ist erst zwei Wochen alt und kocht weiter, obwohl das Wasser schon sprudelt. Ich habe ihn vom Strom getrennt und möchte wissen, wie ich ihn umtauschen kann.
summary: The customer's new kettle fails to switch off when the water boils.

subject: Mein Konto wurde übernommen
body: Ich kann mich nicht mehr anmelden, und die E-Mail-Adresse meines Kontos wurde geändert, ohne dass ich das war. Bitte sperren Sie den Zugang sofort und helfen Sie mir, ihn zurückzubekommen.
summary: The customer reports an account takeover and requests an immediate account lock.

subject: Bitte Zahlungsbeleg erneut zusenden
body: Hallo, die Kartenzahlung für meine Bestellung wurde bestätigt, aber ich finde die Zahlungsbestätigung nicht mehr in meinen E-Mails. Könnten Sie mir den Beleg bitte nochmals schicken?
summary: The customer asks for a replacement receipt for a confirmed card payment.

subject: Rechtsprüfung wegen abgelehntem Aktionsgutschein
body: Auf Ihrer Aktionsseite stand, dass der Gutschein bis Monatsende für alle Haushaltswaren gilt. An der Kasse wird er trotzdem abgelehnt. Wenn Sie das Angebot nicht wie beworben erfüllen, werde ich rechtliche Schritte prüfen lassen.
summary: The customer threatens legal action because an advertised discount code is being rejected.

subject: Rückzahlung ist angekommen
body: Nur zur Rückmeldung: Die Rückzahlung für die zurückgeschickte Jacke ist heute eingegangen. Damit ist alles erledigt, danke für die schnelle Hilfe.
summary: The customer confirms that the refund for a returned jacket arrived and the issue is resolved.

subject: Ketel listrik baru mati sendiri
body: Ketel listrik yang baru saya beli mati sendiri setelah dipanaskan sebentar, padahal airnya belum mendidih. Sudah saya coba di stopkontak lain, hasilnya sama. Bisa dibantu untuk pemeriksaan atau penggantian?
summary: The new electric kettle shuts off before the water boils, even when tested in another outlet.

subject: Tidak bisa masuk ke akun
body: Saya terkunci di luar akun sejak pagi dan perlu mengakses riwayat pesanan hari ini. Tautan reset kata sandi tidak kunjung masuk ke email, termasuk setelah saya cek folder spam. Mohon bantu pulihkan akses saya.
summary: The customer is locked out of their account and password reset emails are not arriving.

subject: Kartu saya tertagih dua kali
body: Pembelian saya hanya sekali, tetapi tagihan kartu menunjukkan dua transaksi dengan nominal yang sama. Mohon periksa dan kembalikan salah satu tagihan secepatnya.
summary: The customer was charged twice for a single purchase and requests a duplicate charge reversal.

subject: Keberatan atas klaim ramah lingkungan
body: Halaman promosi ShopFlow menyebut kemasan kalian sepenuhnya ramah lingkungan, tetapi saya tidak menemukan penjelasan atau bukti yang mendukung klaim itu. Saya belum membeli apa pun. Jika klaim tersebut tidak segera ditinjau, saya akan melaporkannya kepada regulator dan mempertimbangkan tindakan hukum.
summary: The customer disputes an unsupported environmental claim and threatens regulatory action and legal proceedings.

subject: Paket terlambat sehari, tapi sudah diterima
body: Paket saya datang sehari lebih lambat dari perkiraan, tetapi sudah sampai dengan aman. Saya hanya ingin tahu apakah keterlambatan sehari biasanya terjadi saat pengiriman ke daerah saya.
summary: The package arrived one day late, and the customer asks whether this is typical for their area.

subject: Mohon percepat pengembalian dana
body: Saya sudah mengembalikan jaket dan pengembalian dana masih belum masuk. Uang itu saya perlukan untuk membayar sewa yang jatuh tempo minggu ini; kalau terlambat, saya berisiko kehilangan tempat tinggal. Mohon segera bantu prosesnya.
summary: The customer needs an overdue refund urgently to pay rent and avoid losing their housing.

subject: Lampu meja berkedip terus
body: Lampu meja yang saya terima berkedip meskipun sudah memakai bohlam yang sesuai dan mencoba sumber listrik lain. Saya tidak melihat kerusakan pada kabelnya. Bagaimana cara mengajukan pemeriksaan atau penggantian?
summary: The desk lamp keeps flickering despite using a compatible bulb and testing another power source.

subject: Akun saya mungkin diambil alih
body: Saya menerima pemberitahuan bahwa alamat email akun saya diubah, padahal saya tidak melakukannya. Ada juga percobaan masuk dari perangkat yang tidak saya kenal. Tolong segera amankan akun dan pulihkan akses saya.
summary: The customer reports an unauthorized email change and unfamiliar login attempts, suggesting account takeover.

subject: Perlu koreksi nama pada faktur
body: Faktur untuk pembelian saya mencantumkan nama perusahaan yang salah. Bisa bantu menerbitkan ulang faktur dengan nama PT Sinar Pagi? Pembayarannya sudah selesai dan saya hanya perlu dokumen yang benar untuk arsip.
summary: The customer requests a corrected invoice with the proper company name.

subject: Ketentuan undian di situs tidak jelas
body: Ketentuan undian di situs menyatakan pemenang akan diumumkan, tetapi tidak ada tanggal atau cara pengumumannya. Saya belum ikut membeli apa pun, namun aturan promosi seperti ini menyesatkan. Jika tidak segera diperjelas, saya akan mengadukan ShopFlow kepada regulator dan mempertimbangkan gugatan.
summary: The customer says unclear giveaway terms are misleading and threatens a regulatory complaint and lawsuit.

subject: Pequeno atraso na entrega
body: Meu pacote chegou um dia depois da previsão, mas já está comigo. Foi só um pequeno incômodo; queria deixar registrado para vocês acompanharem o prazo.
summary: The package arrived one day late, and the customer reports a minor inconvenience.

subject: Como solicitar devolução e reembolso
body: Comprei uma camisa que não serviu e gostaria de devolvê-la para receber o reembolso. Podem me explicar como iniciar o processo?
summary: The customer wants to return a shirt that did not fit and asks how to get a refund.

subject: Alça frouxa na caneca térmica
body: A alça da caneca térmica veio um pouco frouxa, mas apertei o parafuso e ficou firme. Não preciso de troca; só queria avisar sobre esse detalhe.
summary: The mug handle was loose, but the customer fixed it and does not need a replacement.

subject: Bloqueada fora da minha conta
body: Não consigo entrar na minha conta desde hoje cedo e preciso acessar meus dados para concluir uma compra. A redefinição de senha não está funcionando. Podem me ajudar logo?
summary: The customer is locked out of their account and cannot reset their password.

subject: Endereço antigo na nota fiscal
body: O pagamento foi aprovado normalmente, mas a nota fiscal mostra meu endereço de cobrança antigo. Como posso corrigir esse dado para a próxima emissão?
summary: The customer asks how to update an outdated billing address shown on an invoice.

subject: Esclarecimento sobre a página ambiental
body: Na página institucional do compromisso ambiental, vocês afirmam que compensam as emissões de todas as entregas, mas não encontrei nenhuma fonte ou explicação. Isso parece propaganda enganosa; se não esclarecerem, vou formalizar uma denúncia no Procon.
summary: The customer disputes an environmental claim on the company website and threatens to report it to a consumer agency.

subject: Opção de retirada no ponto
body: Minha entrega chegou direitinho. Para uma próxima compra, dá para escolher um ponto de retirada em vez de receber em casa?
summary: The customer asks whether future deliveries can be sent to a pickup point.

subject: Devolução de calça que não serviu
body: A calça ficou apertada e quero devolvê-la para receber meu dinheiro de volta. Ainda está com as etiquetas; poderiam me orientar sobre o procedimento?
summary: The customer wants to return an unworn pair of pants for a refund and asks for instructions.

subject: Botão do moedor prende às vezes
body: O botão do meu moedor de café ficou preso duas vezes, mas limpei a área e agora está funcionando normalmente. Não preciso de atendimento, só gostaria de registrar o problema.
summary: The grinder button stuck twice, but cleaning it resolved the issue.

subject: Alteraram o e-mail da minha conta
body: Recebi um aviso de que o e-mail da minha conta foi alterado, mas não fui eu. Não consigo mais entrar e estou preocupado que alguém tenha assumido o controle. Bloqueiem o acesso e me ajudem imediatamente.
summary: The customer reports an unauthorized email change and fears their account has been taken over.

subject: Addebito che non riconosco
body: Ho trovato sulla carta un addebito ShopFlow che non ho autorizzato e non riconosco. Temo che i dati della mia carta siano stati usati da qualcun altro: per favore verificate subito.
summary: The customer reports an unauthorized charge and fears their card details were used fraudulently.

subject: Sito non accessibile con screen reader
body: Il vostro sito non funziona correttamente con il mio screen reader: non riesco a leggere prezzi e condizioni di vendita. Se non risolvete il problema, avvierò un'azione legale per la mancata accessibilità.
summary: The customer says the website is inaccessible with a screen reader and threatens legal action.

subject: Aggiornamento del tracking fermo
body: Il tracking del pacco è fermo da quattro giorni sulla stessa dicitura. Potete controllare se la consegna è ancora prevista?
summary: The customer asks for help because tracking has not updated for four days.

subject: Ho bisogno urgente del rimborso
body: Sto aspettando da due settimane il rimborso dell'ordine #9668. Quei soldi mi servono per pagare le bollette questa settimana; vi chiedo di sbloccarlo al più presto.
summary: The overdue refund is needed to cover the customer's bills this week.

subject: Bollitore che fa scintille
body: Il bollitore appena acquistato fa scintille vicino alla base quando lo collego e si sente odore di bruciato. Ho staccato subito la spina: non è sicuro usarlo e vorrei sapere come procedere.
summary: The customer's new kettle sparks and smells burnt, creating a safety hazard.

subject: Non riesco a cambiare l'indirizzo del profilo
body: Nella sezione profilo l'indirizzo salvato non si lascia modificare: dopo aver premuto Salva torna quello vecchio. Potete indicarmi come aggiornarlo?
summary: The customer cannot update the address saved in their profile.

subject: Addebito duplicato per lo stesso acquisto
body: Per l'acquisto dell'ordine #7426 vedo due addebiti identici sulla carta. È stato prelevato denaro in più: controllate e stornate il doppione, per favore.
summary: The customer was charged twice for one purchase and wants the duplicate charge reversed.

subject: Dichiarazione sulle donazioni
body: Sul vostro sito affermate che ogni acquisto finanzia la riforestazione, ma non ho trovato alcuna prova dopo avervi contattati. Se non documentate la dichiarazione o la rimuovete, segnalerò la pratica alle autorità e procederò per vie legali.
summary: The customer disputes the shop's charity claim and threatens legal action.

subject: Pacco mai arrivato
body: Il tracking segna consegnato da tre settimane, ma non ho ricevuto nulla e i vicini non hanno il pacco. Potete rintracciarlo o dirmi come risolvere? Ordine #9316.
summary: The customer has not received a package marked delivered three weeks ago.

subject: Reso della giacca
body: La giacca dell'ordine #23671 mi sta troppo larga. Vorrei restituirla e ricevere il rimborso: potete mandarmi le istruzioni per il reso?
summary: The customer wants to return a jacket that is too large and receive a refund.

subject: Forwarded: Blender stops after a few seconds
body:
Hi, the blender I received in order #4866 starts up, then shuts off after a few seconds even with an empty jar. I’ve tried another outlet and checked the manual. I need it for meal prep this week, so could you arrange a replacement?

Forwarded message:
> From: ShopFlow Support
> We’re sorry it’s giving you trouble. Please try a different outlet and let us know whether the issue continues.

> From: Maya Chen
> I already tried that, and it still cuts out every time.
style: forwarded email thread with quoted repli
summary: The blender repeatedly shuts off despite troubleshooting, and the customer needs a replacement.

subject: Forwarded: Still locked out after password reset
body:
Hello, I can’t get into my ShopFlow account. The reset link takes me back to the sign-in page, and I’ve been through the process three times. I need to access my saved order details today. Please help me get back in.

Forwarded message:
> From: ShopFlow Support
> Please use the password reset link in the latest email and try signing in again.

> From: Jordan Lee
> I did that, but it loops right back to the login page.
style: forwarded email thread with quoted repli
summary: The customer remains locked out because the password reset process loops back to sign-in.

subject: Fwd: Duplicate charge on my card
body:
I’m seeing two identical charges for my order #11631 on my card statement. I only placed the order once. Please reverse the extra charge as soon as possible.

Forwarded message:
> From: ShopFlow Support
> Our records show one completed order. Could you send the dates and amounts shown on your statement?

> From: Priya Nair
> Both charges posted on the same day and are for the same amount.
style: forwarded email thread with quoted repli
summary: The customer says their card was charged twice for one order and requests reversal of the duplicate charge.

subject: Fwd: Question about gift wrapping
body:
Hi there, does your gift-wrapping option cover the whole package, or is it just a ribbon around the box? I’m thinking of adding it to a birthday gift and couldn’t tell from the checkout page.

Forwarded message:
> From: ShopFlow Support

summary: The customer remains locked out after resetting their password and needs immediate access.

subject: ¿Se pueden combinar dos tarjetas?
body: Antes de hacer mi compra, quería preguntar si puedo pagar usando dos tarjetas distintas. No he intentado pagar todavía. Gracias.
summary: The customer asks whether one purchase can be split between two payment cards.

subject: Error al cambiar el mensaje de regalo
body: Quiero corregir el mensaje que añadí al papel de regalo, pero al guardar los cambios vuelve a aparecer el texto anterior. ¿Podrían actualizarlo por mí?
summary: The customer cannot save an updated message for the gift wrapping service.

subject: Suivi de livraison sans mise à jour
body: Bonjour, le suivi de ma commande indique toujours « en préparation » depuis hier. Pouvez-vous me dire si le colis a bien été expédié ?
summary: Le client demande si sa commande, dont le suivi n’a pas changé depuis hier, a été expédiée.

subject: Remboursement nécessaire rapidement
body: Bonjour, j’attends toujours le remboursement de la commande #19859. J’en ai besoin pour payer ma facture d’électricité cette semaine. Merci de traiter cela au plus vite.
summary: Le client attend le remboursement de sa commande et en a besoin pour payer sa facture d’électricité.

subject: Écran de portable inutilisable
body: Bonjour, l’écran de l’ordinateur portable acheté sur la commande #17637 reste noir depuis ce matin. Je ne peux plus travailler du tout. Pouvez-vous organiser une réparation ou un remplacement rapidement ?
summary: L’écran noir de l’ordinateur portable empêche le client de travailler et il demande une réparation ou un remplacement.

subject: Changer le nom affiché sur mon profil
body: Bonjour, est-il possible de modifier le nom affiché sur mon profil ShopFlow sans changer mon adresse e-mail ? Je ne trouve pas l’option dans les paramètres. Merci !
summary: Le client demande comment modifier le nom affiché sur son profil sans changer son adresse e-mail.

subject: Paiement inconnu sur mon relevé
body: Je viens de voir deux débits ShopFlow que je ne reconnais pas sur ma carte. Je n’ai passé aucune commande aujourd’hui et ma banque soupçonne une fraude. Merci de bloquer tout nouveau débit et de vérifier immédiatement.
summary: Le client signale des débits inconnus, soupçonne une fraude et demande le blocage de nouveaux prélèvements.

subject: Le message cadeau disparaît au paiement
body: Bonjour, le texte que je saisis dans le champ « message cadeau » disparaît dès que je passe à l’étape de paiement. J’ai essayé deux fois. Pourriez-vous vérifier ce problème ?
summary: Le message cadeau saisi par le client disparaît au moment de passer au paiement.

subject: Colis toujours absent après trois semaines
body: Bonjour, la commande #7614 n’est toujours pas arrivée après trois semaines et le suivi n’a pas bougé depuis longtemps. J’en ai besoin ; pouvez-vous localiser le colis ou m’indiquer la prochaine étape ?
summary: Le client n’a pas reçu sa commande après trois semaines et demande de localiser le colis.

subject: Dernier délai avant contestation du paiement
body: Cela fait plus d’un mois que j’attends le remboursement de la commande #27558, malgré mes précédentes relances. Si la somme n’est pas remboursée sous 48 heures, je contesterai le paiement auprès de ma banque.
summary: Le client attend son remboursement depuis plus d’un mois et menace de contester le paiement auprès de sa banque.

subject: Écouteur gauche qui coupe par moments
body: Bonjour, l’écouteur gauche de mon casque coupe le son de temps en temps, même après réinitialisation. Le reste fonctionne normalement. Quelle est la procédure pour le faire vérifier ?
summary: L’écouteur gauche du casque coupe par intermittence et le client demande comment le faire vérifier.

subject: Activité suspecte sur mon compte
body: Je reçois des alertes de connexion que je ne reconnais pas et mon adresse de livraison vient d’être modifiée sans mon accord. Je pense que quelqu’un a pris le contrôle de mon compte. Merci de le sécuriser immédiatement.
summary: Le client signale des connexions inconnues et une modification non autorisée de son adresse, signe possible de prise de contrôle du compte.

subject: Karte wird beim Bezahlen abgelehnt
body: Hallo, ich wollte gerade eine Kaffeemühle bestellen, aber meine Karte wird im letzten Schritt abgelehnt. Bei meiner Bank sieht alles normal aus. Können Sie mir sagen, woran das liegen könnte? Viele Grüße, Jana
summary: The customer’s card is declined during checkout and they want to know why.

subject: Buchungsseite für Montage funktioniert nicht
body: Guten Tag, die Seite zur Auswahl eines Montagetermins lädt nach dem Anklicken nur endlos. Der Schrank wird morgen geliefert und ich muss den Termin heute noch festlegen. Können Sie mir bitte helfen?
summary: The customer is blocked from booking an assembly appointment because the scheduling page will not load.

subject: Frage zur Rückgabe eines Pullovers
body: Hallo, ich überlege, einen Pullover zurückzuschicken, den ich vor ein paar Tagen gekauft habe. Wie lange habe ich dafür Zeit und wird der Betrag nach Eingang der Rücksendung erstattet? Danke!
summary: The customer asks about the return period and when a refund is issued.

subject: Kopfhörer lassen sich nicht einschalten
body: Die Bluetooth-Kopfhörer, die ich bei Ihnen gekauft habe, sind komplett tot und lassen sich auch nach mehreren Stunden Laden nicht einschalten. Ich kann sie überhaupt nicht benutzen und musste mir für die Arbeit ein Ersatzpaar besorgen. Bitte sagen Sie mir, wie wir das lösen können.
summary: The customer’s headphones will not power on, leaving them unusable, and the customer had to buy a replacement.

subject: Profilname selbst korrigiert
body: Hallo, in meinem Profil war ein Buchstabe meines Namens falsch. Ich konnte ihn inzwischen selbst ändern, jetzt stimmt alles. Nur als Hinweis: Das Bearbeitungsfeld war etwas schwer zu finden.
summary: The customer corrected a profile name typo themselves and notes that the edit field was hard to find.

subject: Unbekannte Abbuchung auf meiner Karte
body: Auf meiner Kreditkarte ist eine Abbuchung von ShopFlow, die ich nicht vorgenommen habe. Ich habe nichts bestellt und niemandem Zugriff auf die Karte gegeben. Bitte prüfen Sie das sofort; ich vermute, dass meine Zahlungsdaten missbraucht wurden.
summary: The customer reports an unauthorized ShopFlow card charge and suspects their payment details were misused.

subject: Produktsuche ist komplett leer
body: Seit heute liefert die Suche auf Ihrer Website bei jedem Begriff nur eine leere Seite. Ich brauche dringend ein passendes Ladegerät für meinen Arbeitslaptop, kann aber so nichts finden oder bestellen. Bitte beheben Sie das möglichst schnell.
summary: A broken website search is preventing the customer from finding and ordering a needed laptop charger.

subject: Paket seit fast zwei Wochen verschwunden
body: Die Sendungsverfolgung für meine Bestellung #23203 steht seit zwölf Tagen unverändert auf „in Zustellung“. Das Paket ist nie angekommen, und ich habe auch keine Benachrichtigung erhalten. Können Sie bitte herausfinden, wo es geblieben ist?
summary: The customer’s package has been missing for twelve days with no tracking updates or delivery notice.

subject: Rückerstattung bei Rücksendung
body: Ich möchte eine unbenutzte Vase zurückgeben, die mir doch nicht ins Wohnzimmer passt. Bekomme ich den Kaufpreis zurück oder wird der Betrag nur als Guthaben gutgeschrieben?
summary: The customer asks whether returning an unused vase results in a refund or store credit.

subject: Satu sisi headphone tidak berbunyi
body: Halo, headphone nirkabel yang saya terima hanya mengeluarkan suara dari sisi kanan. Saya sudah mencoba memasangkannya ulang ke ponsel, tetapi sisi kiri tetap diam. Bisa dibantu untuk pemeriksaan atau penukaran?
summary: Headphone nirkabel hanya berbunyi di sisi kanan meski sudah dipasangkan ulang.

subject: Pengaturan bahasa profil tidak tersimpan
body: Hai, saya mencoba mengubah bahasa di profil dari Inggris ke Indonesia, tetapi setiap kali halaman dimuat ulang, pengaturannya kembali ke Inggris. Saya masih bisa menggunakan akun, hanya pengaturannya yang tidak bertahan.
summary: Pengaturan bahasa di profil kembali ke Inggris setelah halaman dimuat ulang.

subject: Pembayaran dengan kartu debit
body: Halo, saya berencana memesan beberapa barang. Apakah ShopFlow menerima kartu debit, atau hanya kartu kredit?
summary: Pelanggan menanyakan apakah ShopFlow menerima kartu debit.

subject: Daftar perbandingan produk tidak terbuka
body: Hai, fitur perbandingan produk di situs tidak menampilkan apa pun setelah saya menambahkan barang. Saya sudah mencoba di dua peramban. Mohon dicek, karena fitur ini akan membantu saya memilih.
summary: Fitur perbandingan produk tidak menampilkan barang yang sudah ditambahkan.

subject: Pesanan belum tiba dan pelacakan tidak berubah
body: Pesanan saya, order #29614, belum tiba setelah lebih dari dua minggu dan status pelacakan tidak berubah sejak pertama kali dikirim. Tolong bantu cari tahu keberadaannya; saya sudah menunggu cukup lama.
summary: Pesanan belum tiba lebih dari dua minggu dan pelacakannya tidak diperbarui.

subject: Cara mengembalikan kemeja
body: Halo, kemeja yang saya beli ternyata tidak cocok ukurannya. Barang masih baru dan labelnya belum dilepas. Bagaimana cara mengajukan pengembalian sesuai kebijakan toko?
summary: Pelanggan ingin mengetahui cara mengembalikan kemeja yang tidak cocok ukurannya.

subject: Tombol kecepatan blender macet
body: Blender yang saya beli kemarin berfungsi, tetapi tombol untuk mengatur kecepatannya sulit ditekan dan sering tersangkut. Saya sudah membersihkan bagian luarnya, namun masalahnya tetap ada. Mohon saran untuk langkah berikutnya.
summary: Tombol pengatur kecepatan blender sering tersangkut meski bagian luarnya sudah dibersihkan.

subject: Ada yang masuk ke akun saya
body: Saya menerima notifikasi bahwa alamat email di akun saya diubah, padahal bukan saya yang melakukannya. Sekarang saya tidak bisa masuk dan khawatir orang lain sedang mengakses akun saya. Tolong segera amankan akun dan bantu saya mendapatkannya kembali.
summary: Pelanggan menduga akun diambil alih setelah email diubah tanpa izin dan kini tidak bisa masuk.

subject: Apakah bisa membayar dengan dua metode?
body: Halo, saya ingin membeli beberapa barang dan penasaran apakah satu pesanan bisa dibayar sebagian dengan saldo ShopFlow dan sebagian dengan kartu? Saya belum melakukan pembayaran.
summary: Pelanggan menanyakan apakah satu pesanan dapat dibayar dengan saldo dan kartu.

subject: Pesan hadiah hilang saat lanjut checkout
body: Hai, saya mengetik pesan hadiah untuk pesanan, tetapi teksnya terhapus setiap kali saya lanjut ke halaman berikutnya. Saya sudah mencoba memasukkannya lagi dua kali. Bisa dibantu agar pesan tersebut tersimpan?
summary: Pesan hadiah yang dimasukkan terhapus setiap kali pelanggan melanjutkan checkout.

subject: Entrega chegou um dia depois
body: Olá, meu pacote chegou ontem, um dia depois da previsão. Está tudo certo com o conteúdo; só queria deixar registrado o pequeno atraso.
summary: The package arrived one day late, but everything is fine.

subject: Preciso do estorno com urgência
body: Estou aguardando o estorno do pedido #25775. Esse dinheiro é para comprar meus remédios e preciso dele até sexta-feira; sem o valor, não consigo pagar a próxima compra. Podem verificar, por favor?
summary: The customer urgently needs an overdue refund to afford medication.

subject: Botão da cafeteira falha às vezes
body: A cafeteira liga normalmente, mas o botão de preparo falha de vez em quando e preciso apertá-lo algumas vezes. Não há sinais de dano ou risco, mas gostaria de saber como resolver.
summary: The coffee maker's brew button intermittently fails and needs troubleshooting.

subject: Acho que alguém tomou acesso à minha conta
body: Recebi um aviso de que o e-mail da minha conta foi alterado, mas não fui eu. Também vejo uma sessão desconhecida e não consigo redefinir a senha. Preciso que bloqueiem o acesso não autorizado imediatamente.
summary: The customer reports an unauthorized account email change and unknown session.

subject: Dúvida sobre lançamento pendente no cartão
body: No aplicativo do banco aparece um lançamento da ShopFlow como pendente. Isso é só uma autorização temporária que será confirmada depois? Ainda não vejo uma cobrança concluída.
summary: The customer asks whether a pending ShopFlow card entry is a temporary authorization.

subject: Informação institucional incorreta sobre embalagens
body: A página institucional da ShopFlow afirma que todas as embalagens são certificadas como recicláveis, mas o atendimento me informou que isso não é verdade. Se a informação não for corrigida, vou encaminhar uma denúncia e iniciar uma ação judicial.
summary: The customer disputes a company-wide packaging claim and threatens legal action if it is not corrected.

subject: Pacote desaparecido e vou contestar a compra
body: Meu pedido #28387 está sem atualização há três semanas e não chegou. Já tentei acompanhar a entrega, mas não há informações novas. Se não resolverem isso logo, vou contestar a cobrança com o cartão.
summary: The order has been missing for three weeks, and the customer threatens a card dispute.

subject: Quero devolver uma jaqueta
body: A jaqueta do pedido #17176 ficou grande demais. Quero devolvê-la dentro do prazo e receber o reembolso; podem me enviar as instruções para a postagem?
summary: The customer wants to return a jacket that is too large and receive a refund.

subject: Costura soltando na mochila
body: Comprei uma mochila e notei que uma costura lateral começou a se soltar após poucos dias de uso. Ela ainda pode ser usada e não oferece risco, mas gostaria de saber se há uma solução ou troca.
summary: A side seam on the customer's backpack is coming undone after a few days of use.

subject: Minha conta parece comprometida
body: Não consigo entrar na minha conta e recebi um alerta de tentativa de acesso de um dispositivo que não reconheço. Também chegou uma notificação de alteração de senha que não solicitei. Por favor, protejam a conta e me ajudem a recuperar o acesso.
summary: The customer reports an unknown login attempt and an unauthorized password change.

subject: Addebito doppio sullo stesso acquisto
body: Buongiorno, per l’acquisto delle cuffie vedo due addebiti identici sulla carta, anche se ho completato il pagamento una sola volta. Potete verificare e stornarne uno?
summary: The customer was charged twice for one purchase and asks ShopFlow to reverse the duplicate charge.

subject: Non riesco ad accedere alla consulenza di arredamento
body: Ho una consulenza video gratuita con il vostro esperto d’arredo tra dieci minuti, ma il link continua a dare errore. L’esperto mi aspetta e non riesco a partecipare: potete aiutarmi subito?
summary: The customer cannot join a scheduled furniture consultation because its video link is failing.

subject: Rimborso ancora non ricevuto
body: Ho restituito il cappotto tre settimane fa e mi avevate confermato il rimborso, ma sulla carta non è ancora comparso. Potete controllare a che punto è?
summary: The customer returned a coat three weeks ago but has not received the confirmed refund.

subject: Il macinacaffè fa un rumore insolito
body: Il macinacaffè è arrivato senza danni e funziona, però da ieri fa un rumore metallico mentre gira. Non sembra bloccato: mi consigliate di pulirlo in qualche modo?
summary: The customer’s working coffee grinder has developed an unusual metallic noise and they ask for troubleshooting advice.

subject: Errore quando provo a cambiare il numero di telefono
body: Riesco ad accedere al mio profilo, ma quando salvo il nuovo numero compare un messaggio di errore. Potete indicarmi come aggiornarlo?
summary: The customer can log in but cannot update their phone number because the profile page shows an error.

subject: Addebito che non riconosco sulla carta
body: Ho appena notato un pagamento ShopFlow che non ho autorizzato e non corrisponde a nessuno dei miei acquisti. Ho già bloccato la carta con la banca; verificate subito l’origine dell’addebito e proteggete il mio account.
summary: The customer reports an unauthorized ShopFlow card charge and asks for an urgent investigation after blocking the card.

subject: Non si apre il collegamento per la consulenza
body: La consulenza video per scegliere i colori del soggiorno inizia tra pochi minuti, ma il collegamento continua a riportarmi alla pagina iniziale. L’esperto è già collegato e io sono bloccata: potete mandarmi un link funzionante?
summary: The customer cannot join a scheduled color consultation because its video link keeps redirecting them.

subject: Pacco fermo da settimane
body: Per l’ordine #24471 il tracking non cambia da quasi un mese e la consegna prevista è passata da tempo. Non ho ricevuto nulla: potete rintracciare il pacco o dirmi come procedere?
summary: The customer has not received an order whose tracking has been unchanged for nearly a month.

subject: Rimborso della giacca non accreditato
body: Ho fatto il reso della giacca e il tracking conferma che è arrivata al vostro magazzino da oltre due settimane, ma il rimborso non è ancora stato accreditato. Potete verificare?
summary: The customer’s returned jacket reached the warehouse over two weeks ago, but the refund has not been credited.

subject: Re: Forwarded: Toaster lever won't stay down
body:
Hi ShopFlow,

I’m forwarding my exchange with support about the new toaster. The lever pops back up unless I hold it down, so I can’t toast anything normally. Could you help me arrange a fix?

Forwarded conversation:
> Support: Could you describe what happens when you press the lever?
> Me: It clicks briefly, then springs back up. The toaster is plugged in and otherwise seems fine.

Thanks,
Maya
style: forwarded email thread with quoted repli
summary: The toaster lever keeps popping back up, and the customer needs help getting it fixed.

subject: Fwd: Changing the name on my profile
body:
Hello,

Could someone tell me how to change the name shown on my ShopFlow profile? I can find the address and phone fields, but not the display name.

Forwarded reply:
> Support: Are you trying to change your billing name or your profile display name?
> Me: Just the display name other shoppers see.

Best,
Elliot
style: forwarded email thread with quoted repli
summary: The customer wants to know how to change their profile display name.

subject: Fwd: Question about the tax line on my receipt
body:
Hi there,

I’m trying to understand the tax line on my receipt. Is it based on the delivery address, or does it vary by product?

Forwarded message:
> Support: Please let us know which part of the receipt is unclear.
> Me: I’m only asking how the tax amount is calculated; I’m not disputing a charge.

Regards,
Nina
style: forwarded email thread with quoted repli
summary: The customer asks how the tax amount shown on a receipt is calculated.

subject: Fwd: How do I return a shirt?
body:
Hi,

I’m forwarding my question about returning a shirt that didn’t fit. It’s unworn with the tags still on. Could you send me the steps for starting a return?

Forwarded reply:
> Support: Are you looking for a refund or an exchange?
> Me: A refund would be best, but I just need to know how to begin.

Thank you,
Caleb
style: forwarded email thread with quoted repli
summary: The customer asks how to start a return for an unworn shirt that did not fit.

subject: Fwd: Desk lamp switch is finicky
body:
Hi ShopFlow,

The switch on my desk lamp only worked intermittently at first. I found that the plug wasn’t fully seated in the adapter, and it’s been working normally since I fixed that. Just wanted to flag the issue in case it’s useful.

Forwarded reply:
> Support: Does the switch still fail after checking the connection?
> Me: No, it’s been fine since I reseated the plug.

Best,
Priya
style: forwarded email thread with quoted repli
summary: The desk lamp switch initially worked intermittently, but the customer resolved the issue by reseating the plug.

subject: Fwd: Someone changed the email on my account
body:
ShopFlow Support,

I received a notice that the email address on my account was changed, but I didn’t make that change. I can’t get into the account now, and the password reset messages aren’t reaching me. Please secure the account immediately; I’m worried someone else has access.

Forwarded reply:
> Support: Can you still sign in using your previous email address?
> Me: No, and I did not authorize the change.

Please help urgently,
Derek
style: forwarded email thread with quoted repli
summary: The customer suspects account takeover after an unauthorized email change and is locked out.

subject: Fwd: I was charged twice for the same purchase
body:
Hello,

My card statement shows two identical ShopFlow charges for one purchase. Both have posted, and I need the duplicate charge reversed. Please check this as soon as possible.

Forwarded exchange:
> Support: Do you see one charge or two on your statement?
> Me: Two posted charges for the same amount on the same day.

Regards,
Ava
style: forwarded email thread with quoted repli
summary: The customer says two identical charges have posted for one purchase and requests reversal of the duplicate.

subject: Fwd: Gift message field keeps crashing the cart
body:
Hi,

I’m trying to place a gift order, but the cart crashes every time I type in the gift message field. I’ve tried twice on different browsers, and I can’t complete the purchase without adding the message. Please help get this fixed so I can finish checking out.

Forwarded reply:
> Support: Does the cart crash if you leave the gift message blank?
> Me: Yes, but the message is important for this gift.

Thanks,
Leah
style: forwarded email thread with quoted repli
summary: The gift message field crashes the cart, preventing the customer from completing a purchase.

subject: Tracking texts kept coming after delivery
body: My coffee grinder arrived yesterday, but I’m STILL getting tracking alerts saying it’s out for delivery. Please make the messages stop; the package is already here.

subject: WHERE IS MY OVERDUE REFUND?
body: I returned the winter coat weeks ago and still don’t have my money back. This is completely unacceptable—please process the refund now for order #10795.
summary: The customer says their refund for a returned coat is overdue.

subject: The blender arrived with a cracked lid
body: The blender lid has a crack straight across it, which is NOT what I paid for. The base works, but I need a replacement lid. Please sort this out.
summary: The customer received a blender with a cracked lid and wants a replacement.

subject: Can’t update my profile email
body: I’m trying to change the email on my profile, but the save button just spins and does nothing. This is so frustrating. Please fix it.
summary: The customer cannot save a new email address to their profile.

subject: Invoice has the wrong billing name
body: The invoice for my headphones has my old billing name on it. I’ve checked my profile and the new name is there, so WHY is the invoice wrong? Please correct it.
summary: The customer says their headphones invoice shows the wrong billing name.

subject: Where is the size guide for these curtains?
body: I’ve looked at the curtain listing on my phone and there is NO size guide anywhere. How am I supposed to know what to order? Please point me to it.
summary: The customer cannot find a size guide for curtains and wants help locating it.

subject: MY PACKAGE HAS BEEN MISSING FOR AGES
body: My order still hasn’t arrived, and tracking hasn’t changed in over three weeks. This is absurd. I need an actual update or a solution for order #9683.
summary: The customer’s package has not arrived and tracking has been unchanged for over three weeks.

subject: Returning these shoes—why is the label so hard to find?
body: The shoes don’t fit, and I want to return them, but I’ve been clicking through your site forever and cannot find the return label. This process is a mess. Please tell me how to get one.
summary: The customer wants to return shoes that do not fit but cannot find the return label.

subject: Small issue with a shirt button
body: I’m writing from the train after a weekend visiting my sister, and I’ve been trying to get better about packing light because I always bring too many books. The linen shirt in order #1218 arrived with one loose button. It was an easy fix, though—I sewed it back on myself before wearing the shirt, so there’s nothing you need to do. I just wanted to mention it in case it’s useful feedback for whoever checks the stitching.
style: long and rambling, with irrelevant perso
summary: A shirt arrived with a loose button, which the customer has already sewn back on.

subject: Changing the name shown in my profile
body: I’ve recently started using a shorter version of my name with friends, mostly because people kept misspelling the longer one on coffee orders, and it’s been a surprisingly pleasant change.
